meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后,Codex 在成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑工具后,会收到 comment-checker 的反馈。若反馈有警告,Codex 必须先修复或解释被标记的评论,才能继续。
howto.when: 触发于 Codex 成功调用 apply_patch、write、edit 等多类编辑工具之后;非编辑工具及检查器缺失时不触发。

say.text: 修复刚才 comment-checker 标记的评论。
say.note: Codex 会修改对应注释以消除警告。

say.text: 解释一下这条警告的原因。
say.note: Codex 会向你说明问题所在。

say.text: 把这条警告涉及的评论改一下。
say.note: Codex 会调整该评论并继续。

howto.what_en: After install, Codex receives automatic comment-checker feedback after successful edit-like calls (apply_patch, write, edit, multi_edit, etc.). If a warning is reported, Codex must fix or explain the flagged comment before moving on.
howto.when_en: Triggers after a successful edit-like tool call via a PostToolUse hook. Non-edit tools and missing checker binaries produce no output.

say_en.text: Fix the comment that comment-checker flagged.
say_en.note: Codex will edit the comment to clear the warning.

say_en.text: Update the comment involved in this warning.
say_en.note: Codex will adjust it and continue.
